cards.front: What does per cent mean?
cards.say: What does per cent mean? Out of one hundred. Thirty five per cent means thirty five out of one hundred.

cards.front: 1/2 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: One half as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point five and fifty per cent

figure.alt: A bar split into 2 equal parts with 1 shaded

cards.front: 1/4 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: One quarter as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point two five and twenty five per cent

figure.alt: A bar split into 4 equal parts with 1 shaded

cards.front: 3/4 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: Three quarters as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point seven five and seventy five per cent

figure.alt: A bar split into 4 equal parts with 3 shaded

cards.front: 1/5 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: One fifth as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point two and twenty per cent

cards.front: 2/5 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: Two fifths as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point four and forty per cent

cards.front: 3/5 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: Three fifths as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point six and sixty per cent

cards.front: 4/5 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: Four fifths as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point eight and eighty per cent

cards.front: 1/10 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: One tenth as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point one and ten per cent

cards.front: 3/10 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: Three tenths as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point three and thirty per cent

cards.front: 9/10 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: Nine tenths as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point nine and ninety per cent

cards.front: 1/100 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: One hundredth as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point zero one and one per cent

cards.front: 7/100 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: Seven hundredths as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point zero seven and seven per cent

cards.front: 1/20 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: One twentieth as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point zero five and five per cent. Think: five hundredths equals one twentieth.

cards.front: 3/20 as a decimal and a percentage
cards.say: Three twentieths as a decimal and a percentage. Zero point one five and fifteen per cent. Think: fifteen hundredths equals three twentieths.

cards.front: 0.35 as a fraction in simplest form
cards.back: 7/20. 0.35 = 35/100, and dividing top and bottom by 5 gives 7/20.
cards.say: Zero point three five as a fraction in simplest form. Seven twentieths. Zero point three five equals thirty five hundredths, and dividing top and bottom by five gives seven twentieths.

cards.front: 60% as a fraction in simplest form
cards.back: 3/5. 60/100 divided top and bottom by 20 gives 3/5.
cards.say: Sixty per cent as a fraction in simplest form. Three fifths. Sixty hundredths divided top and bottom by twenty gives three fifths.

cards.front: 45% as a decimal
cards.say: Forty five per cent as a decimal. Zero point four five

cards.front: 0.6 as a percentage
cards.say: Zero point six as a percentage. Sixty per cent. Zero point six equals six tenths equals sixty hundredths.

cards.back: 40. 50% is one half, and half of 80 is 40.
cards.say: Fifty per cent of eighty. Forty. Fifty per cent is one half, and half of eighty is forty.
Twenty five per cent of one hundred and twenty. Thirty. Twenty five per cent is one quarter, and one hundred and twenty divided by four equals thirty.
Ten per cent of three hundred and fifty. Thirty five. To find ten per cent, divide by ten.
Twenty per cent of sixty. Twelve. Ten per cent is six, so twenty per cent is twelve.

cards.front: Which is bigger, 0.3 or 25%?
cards.say: Which is bigger, zero point three or twenty five per cent? Zero point three, because zero point three equals thirty per cent and thirty per cent is more than twenty five per cent.
